owner_direction: After every shot, token memory is cleared and rebuilt with the proper elements instead of merging into a single project.
forbid: Carry prompt text, paraphrased anatomy, or invented prop design from a previous shot
Batch-generate multiple shots from one accumulated session
Describe an unbound character or prop with new physical details
Point PROP-PLANE at REF-850d9614 (HUD board) as generation pixels
allow_carry_forward: The owner-approved opening or endpoint file, rebound by exact hash as SOURCE_1 of the next REQUEST only
request_must_contain: Exactly 2 or 3 source_references with roles and sha256
verbatim_identity for every CHAR in exact_cast that is bound
verbatim_props for every PROP that is bound
still_prompt assembled only from CARD action/camera/room_state plus copied prompt_phrases

slot_recipe.SOURCE_1: Location plate, or the approved previous opening/endpoint of this same room (bytes, not memory)
slot_recipe.SOURCE_2: The identity this shot is most likely to reinvent (Daddy, Eagle, play-bunny, plane, rocket)
slot_recipe.SOURCE_3: Tool, second character, or second prop. Never a board.

overflow_rule: If exact_cast + location + props need more than 3 files, do not text-fill the fourth. Split into a prior PREP lock still that already contains the extra identity, then bind that lock as SOURCE_1. If no lock exists, the shot is BLOCKED.
